scientific.integrity: The displayed AdaX recurrence is solved exactly under a one-coordinate isolated-gradient input; the gain monotonicity and sharp ceiling are proved analytically.
limitations: Sparse input-response theorem rather than fixed-objective global convergence.
Constant step size and no added denominator regularizer.
Persistent stochastic-noise behavior is not classified.

title: Exact sparse-impulse gain law for AdaX long-term memory
